message:
The users test passes now, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`, which caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the API to use `fullname` and left `migrations/` alone, as you asked.
